name: thefantasytool
description: TheFantasyTool's fantasy-sports predictions in ChatGPT: captains, transfers, player scans and fixtures for the games TheFantasyTool covers.

interface.longDescription:
TheFantasyTool predicts fantasy points for every player in the fantasy games it covers - Fantasy Premier League, the holdet.dk managers, UCL Fantasy, Bundesliga, Allsvenskan, Eliteserien, NFL fantasy and more. Connect your TheFantasyTool account and ask ChatGPT about your team: who to captain this gameweek, the best single transfer for your squad and bank, which players are the best value at a position and price, and how a club's next fixtures look. Every number comes from TheFantasyTool's own model - predicted points, expected minutes, start probability, expected goals and assists, clean-sheet probability.

It's for fantasy managers who want a second opinion grounded in data rather than gut feel, without leaving the conversation.

Sign in with your existing TheFantasyTool account.

Limitations: transfer advice covers one transfer at a time - multi-transfer plans and chips use the Team Planner on thefantasytool.com. Selling prices are taken as current prices, so budgets in games with lower selling prices (FPL) are approximate. The plugin is read-only and never changes your fantasy team. Fantasy advice only; no betting advice.
capabilities: Captain picks from your squad or the whole game
Best single transfer for your squad and bank
Player scans by position, club and price
Fixtures with win and clean-sheet probabilities
Covered games and what your account includes
defaultPrompt: Who are the best FPL captains this gameweek according to TheFantasyTool?
Find the best FPL midfielders under 7.0m for the next 3 gameweeks.
Here is my FPL team - what is my best single transfer?

positive.description: Captain picks across the whole game
positive.prompt: Who are the best FPL captains this gameweek according to TheFantasyTool?
positive.expected_behavior: Names 3-5 Fantasy Premier League players ranked by TheFantasyTool's predicted points for the current gameweek, each with predicted points, predicted minutes and the fixture. No numbers that the tool did not return.

positive.description: Market scan by position and price
positive.prompt: Which FPL midfielders under 7.0m have the most predicted points over the next 3 gameweeks?
positive.expected_behavior: A ranked list of FPL midfielders priced 7.0m or less, each with price, predicted points per gameweek, the 3-gameweek total and fixtures.

positive.description: Best single transfer for a named squad
positive.prompt: My FPL team: Lukas Hornicek, Matz Sels, Riccardo Calafiori, Ezri Konsa, Josko Gvardiol, Antonee Robinson, Jarrad Branthwaite, Bryan Mbeumo, Morgan Rogers, Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall, Dominik Szoboszlai, Harvey Barnes, Joao Pedro, Kai Havertz, Gonzalo Garcia. 7.5m in the bank, 1 free transfer. What's my best transfer?
positive.expected_behavior: Recommends selling one named squad player and buying one named player in the same position within the budget, with the gain in predicted team points over the next gameweeks and the bank afterwards; notes that selling prices are approximate.

positive.prompt: Compare Arsenal's and Chelsea's next 3 FPL fixtures.
positive.expected_behavior: For each club, the next 3 opponents with home/away, win probability and clean-sheet probability, and a short comparison of which run is easier.

positive.description: Covered games, then a scan in another game
positive.prompt: Which fantasy games does TheFantasyTool cover? Then show me the top Allsvenskan Fantasy forwards for the next round.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the games TheFantasyTool currently covers, then a ranked list of Allsvenskan Fantasy forwards with predicted points for the next round.

negative.description: Betting advice is out of scope: fantasy advice only, no odds or bets
negative.prompt: What odds should I bet on for Arsenal vs Chelsea this weekend?

negative.description: Unrelated requests should not trigger the plugin
negative.prompt: What's the weather in London tomorrow?

negative.description: A fantasy game TheFantasyTool does not cover: it should say so and list the covered games, not invent predictions
negative.prompt: Who should I captain in Fantasy Formula E this week?

review.commerce_description: Nothing is sold, priced or promoted in ChatGPT. Users sign in to their existing TheFantasyTool account; when that account does not include a game, the plugin says so in one neutral sentence, with no plans, trials or links.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.2: reviewer sign-in fixed. Our sign-in page now asks for the password straight after the email, with no emailed code, no magic link and no 2FA, so the supplied review account signs in immediately. No change to the tools. Includes 1.0.1: TheFantasyTool's predicted points in ChatGPT - captain picks, best single transfer, player scans by position and price, fixtures, and the list of covered games.
